userStories.title: Create reverse_settlement Edge Function
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need to reverse a settlement when mistakes happen.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/reverse_settlement/index.ts
Handle OPTIONS request for CORS preflight
Extract and validate JWT from Authorization header to get user_id
Accept JSON body: bet_id, reason (required string, not empty), idempotency_key
Validate: bet exists, belongs to bookie, status is 'settled'
Check idempotency - return cached response if key exists
Find the original settlement ledger_entry for this bet
In transaction: update bet status back to 'graded', create reversing ledger_entry with opposite amount and type 'reversal'
Emit audit event with action_type 'reverse', previous_state, new_state, and reason
Store idempotency key with response
Return { success: true, bet: <updated bet>, reversal_entry: <created ledger entry> }
Typecheck passes (Deno)

userStories.title: Create override_grade Edge Function
userStories.description: As a bookie, I need to change a bet's grade when disputes arise.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/override_grade/index.ts
Handle OPTIONS request for CORS preflight
Extract and validate JWT from Authorization header to get user_id
Accept JSON body: bet_id, new_outcome (win, loss, push, void), reason (required string, not empty), idempotency_key
Validate: bet exists, belongs to bookie, has been graded (grade_result is not null)
Check idempotency - return cached response if key exists
If bet status is 'settled', first call reverse_settlement logic internally to undo settlement
Update bet grade_result to new_outcome, keep status as 'graded'
Emit audit event with action_type 'override', previous grade in previous_state, new grade in new_state, and reason
Store idempotency key with response
Return { success: true, bet: <updated bet>, settlement_reversed: boolean }
Typecheck passes (Deno)
